# log-pattern-miner

> Online log template mining with the Drain fixed-depth tree, deterministic cluster ids, JSON state and a CLI that reports patterns missing from a baseline Python package `trysac-log-pattern-miner`, import name `log_pattern_miner`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
